title: Pure Melodious
summary: Pure Melodious Pendulum-Fusion build with modern legacy support and generic staples. Combining LIGHT Fairy Pendulum monsters with Fusion Spells, the deck swarms materials directly from the Deck to produce multi-bounce bosses, graveyard hate, and blanket protection.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ostinato Fusion Summons a Melodious Fusion Monster using materials straight from your hand or Deck if you control no monsters.
Refrain the Melodious Songstress adds a Melodious monster from Deck to hand when Normal or Special Summoned; as a Scale, it sends a Melodious monster from Deck to GY.
Couplet the Melodious Songstress adds a Melodious Spell/Trap from Deck to hand via its Pendulum effect, and Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Melodious when added to hand.
1st Movement Solo Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Melodious monster directly from your Deck into an empty board.

summary.title: Opening: Ostinato
steps: Activate Ostinato while controlling no monsters, sending Refrain the Melodious Songstress and Couplet the Melodious Songstress from your Deck to the GY to Fusion Summon Bacha the Melodious Maestra.
Bacha triggers on Fusion Summon to Special Summon Soprano the Melodious Songstress (or Aria the Melodious Diva) from your Deck.
Refrain and Couplet trigger in the GY upon a Melodious Fusion Summon, placing themselves face-up into your Pendulum Zones.
Activate Couplet's Pendulum effect to search Melodious Concerto from your Deck.
Activate Melodious Concerto to fuse Bacha and Soprano into Flowering Etoile the Melodious Magnificat.
Bacha's GY effect revives a Melodious monster from your GY, while Concerto recycles itself into the Deck to draw 1 card.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Flowering Etoile the Melodious Magnificat can banish any number of Melodious monsters you control until the End Phase as a Quick Effect to bounce that many face-up cards your opponent controls to the hand.

Bacha the Melodious Maestra prevents opponent activations when your Melodious monsters declare attacks or activate effects, Special Summons a Melodious from Deck on summon, and revives a Melodious from GY if sent there.
Schuberta the Melodious Maestra banishes up to three cards from either GY as a Quick Effect and gains 200 ATK for each card banished.

Bloom Diva the Melodious Choir cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, reflects all battle damage from battles involving Special Summoned monsters, and destroys the opposing monster after damage calculation.
Aria the Melodious Diva prevents Special Summoned Melodious monsters from being targeted by card effects or destroyed by battle while face-up.
Bloom Harmonist the Melodious Composer discards a card on Link Summon to Special Summon two Melodious monsters with different Levels from your Deck.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ostinato fuses directly from the Deck with zero setup on an empty board.
Melodious Concerto fuses using monsters from hand, field, or face-up Pendulum Zones, and recycles itself from the GY to draw a card.
1st Movement Solo summons a starter like Refrain directly from the Deck.
Fortissimo provides continuous ATK boosts and can send itself to the GY to Fusion Summon from the field.
